name: chai
description: Co-fold protein/complex/ligand structures with Chai-1 on Aurora XPU; one row per fold, returns cif + interface scores.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool chai.fold(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls the loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). Install paths come from site.<system>.json, resolved worker-side.
